name: trick or tricker
source:
It was late afternoon on October 31st.
I was having tea with my twin sister in a relaxed church.

I wondered if we would have any guests again this year.

Every year, nothing happens on Halloween, 
but this year, there was a knock at the door.

I had no way of knowing if it was a blessing or a curse.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/10384]Freem[/url]]
